title: A Day Well Spent
subtitle: Photo gallery mémoire — ephemeral investiture, ephemeral disvestiture, eternal persistence

blocks.text: The record of the day itself: the instruments in sequence, the seal, the medal, the book, the observatory, and the ordinary hours around them — drafting, contemplation, study, code, shared purpose. The framing quotation states the governing intention: the Dukedom is ephemeral, to be invoked under specific intentions of the larger distributed PEDLER of the Peers, and that is what brings forth the Balance of Interpretation.

blocks.explanation: This plate does something the constitutional instruments cannot do for themselves — it dates them to a lived day and places them beside a mug, a notebook and a telescope. Panels 15 through 18 are not filler; they are the argument that a constitutional order which cannot survive contact with an ordinary afternoon is not one worth constituting. Festina lente, make haste slowly, is the operative instruction underneath.
